findings.problem: This diff reverts commit 542d5dd (`fix(walkthrough): General settings fields lived in a separate form from the Save button, so saving never submitted them`), reintroducing the exact bug that commit fixed and tested against. Before this diff, General-section inputs lived in a plain <div> and carried `form="settings-form"`, associating them with the bottom <form id="settings-form"> that holds the 'Save Settings' button, so one submit sent both General and instance fields together. This diff puts the General fields back into their own standalone `<form method="post" action="{{ request.url_for('save_settings') }}">` (settings.html:18-90) that has no submit control, and strips `id="settings-form"` from the instances form (settings.html:134) along with every `form="settings-form"` attribute. Clicking the only 'Save Settings' button (settings.html:241-244) now submits solely the instances `<form>`; none of log_level, hard_max_per_cycle, max_history_rows, request_timeout, page_size, tracking_window_minutes, max_consecutive_failures, or skip_unreleased are present in that POST. In `triggarr/web/routes.py` save_settings (unchanged by this diff, lines 530-540), every one of those fields is read via `form.get(...)` with a hardcoded fallback default (not the current persisted value) when absent -- e.g. `safe_int(form.get("hard_max_per_cycle"), 0, 0, 1000)` and `form.get("skip_unreleased") == "on"` -- so every normal 'add/edit an *arr instance and Save' action silently overwrites administrator-configured General settings with defaults (hard_max_per_cycle -> 0/unlimited, request_timeout -> 30, tracking_window_minutes -> 60, max_consecutive_failures -> 5, skip_unreleased -> False, log_level -> 'info'), and the General section itself becomes unsavable from the UI since its form has no submit button. This exact scenario is guarded by `tests/test_web.py::test_general_fields_submit_with_the_save_settings_form` (added in 542d5dd), which asserts `id="settings-form"` exists and every General control carries `form="settings-form"` -- both assertions fail against this diff's markup.

That makes the daemon start searching for unreleased items.
